_about: Market-of-one (spec 3.12, 7.17). One viewer market: Cleveland, DMA 510. localTeams are the clubs whose local feeds this market receives; postalCode drives the NHL postal-lookup territory check (adapters/nhl.py). Edit here; adapters read this file directly. nhl.outOfMarketPackage is the out-of-market package rule (adapters/nhl.py, prompt 128): a regular-season NHL game with no US national row and neither club a local team takes one row for its outlet, ESPN+; deleting the key turns the rule off.

nfl.coverageSource: EntitledSports' weekly coverage pages (entitledsports.com/schedule/nfl/coverage-map/week-N/, read by adapters/es_windows.py; unofficial, prompt 118, register 63); then the Cleveland affiliates' own TV listings from Schedules Direct (adapters/sd_listings.py, dormant without the SD_* secrets, wins when present); then data/market_coverage_nfl.json, a hand override that wins over both when an entry exists

nhl.territorySource: api-web.nhle.com/v1/postal-lookup (2026-09-01: Columbus Blue Jackets, Summit County OH, networkType Sphere)
